anchors.published_interpretation: The Heraklion Archaeological Museum describes the jar inscription as probably indicating origin at Sybrita/Syvrita.
anchors.archaeological_observation: The museum states that both inscriptions on pithos Pi3915 were incised before firing.
cautions: The museum's geographical interpretation is probable, not an established word-by-word translation.
The observed relation is not simple addition of JA to SU-KI-RI-TA.
No sound law, grammatical case, or meaning for JA is inferred here.
Possible maker, affiliation, ownership, container-origin and contents-origin interpretations remain distinct.
The digital source and commentary are derivative editions, not independent epigraphic witnesses. Photographs were not inspected in this phase.
Alternative personal-name readings have been proposed; this workflow does not adjudicate language-family claims.
